name: anibon-stream-synthesis
description: Subagent pipeline enforcer. Prevents orchestrator from bypassing subagent-prompt-template.md.
root_cause: subagent-prompt-template.md exists but orchestrator writes ad-hoc prompts — no OUTPUT CONTRACT, no density self-check, no inline JSON. Subagents produce vague output. Orchestrator falls back to manual stamps → lost domain depth.
fix: scripts/subagent-prompt-builder.py — canonical prompt from template, 1 chunk per agent, strict contract
scripts/preflight-gate.py — analyzer + detect_topics before any spawn
scripts/assembly-gate.py — dedup, caveman headers, gap audit

enforcement.rule: subagent-prompt-template.md MUST be loaded and populated before any subagent spawn.
